auth.label: API Key
auth.description: HARPA GRID API key from your HARPA AI account: https://harpa.ai/

actions.name: run_ai_command
actions.description: Run a built-in or custom HARPA AI command in a connected browser node and return its result.

url.description: The complete web page URL to open in the HARPA browser node.

name.description: The built-in or custom HARPA command name to execute.

inputs.description: Values supplied to successive user-input steps in the HARPA command.

resultParam.description: The HARPA parameter to return, using dot notation when needed; defaults to the last message.

anyOf.description: One node ID or a space-separated list of node IDs.
The number of available nodes to use.

node.description: The HARPA browser nodes to use.

timeout.description: The synchronous execution timeout in milliseconds.

connection.description: The title or ID of the HARPA AI connection to use; the default connection is used when omitted or not found.

inputSchema.description: The HARPA AI command to run in a browser node.

result.description: The JSON result returned by HARPA GRID; its shape depends on the selected nodes and action.

actions.name: run_ai_prompt
actions.description: Run an AI prompt, optionally with a web page as context, in a connected HARPA browser node.

url.description: The complete web page URL to open in the HARPA browser node.

anyOf.description: One node ID or a space-separated list of node IDs.
The number of available nodes to use.

node.description: The HARPA browser nodes to use.

timeout.description: The synchronous execution timeout in milliseconds.

connection.description: The title or ID of the HARPA AI connection to use; the default connection is used when omitted or not found.

inputSchema.description: The AI prompt and optional browser context to run through HARPA GRID.

result.description: The JSON result returned by HARPA GRID; its shape depends on the selected nodes and action.

actions.name: scrape_web_page
actions.description: Scrape a web page as Markdown or extract selected elements through a connected HARPA browser node.

url.description: The complete web page URL to open in the HARPA browser node.

selector.description: A CSS, XPath, or text selector for the target element.

anyOf.description: A zero-based or negative element index.

at.description: Which matching element or elements to capture.

take.description: The element property, attribute, or style value to extract.

label.description: The key to use for this extracted value in the result.

items.description: A page element selector and the value to extract from matching elements.

grab.description: The page elements to extract; omit this field to return page Markdown.

anyOf.description: One node ID or a space-separated list of node IDs.
The number of available nodes to use.

node.description: The HARPA browser nodes to use.

timeout.description: The synchronous execution timeout in milliseconds.

inputSchema.description: The web page and optional element selectors to scrape through HARPA GRID.

result.description: The JSON result returned by HARPA GRID; its shape depends on the selected nodes and action.

actions.name: search_web
actions.description: Search the web through a connected HARPA browser node.

query.description: The search query, including optional operators such as site:example.com or intitle:keyword.

anyOf.description: One node ID or a space-separated list of node IDs.
The number of available nodes to use.

node.description: The HARPA browser nodes to use.

timeout.description: The synchronous execution timeout in milliseconds.

inputSchema.description: The web search to run through HARPA GRID.

result.description: The JSON result returned by HARPA GRID; its shape depends on the selected nodes and action.
